add.title: Retire or quarantine the core/new/1/site sketch pages: they load on the live site and throw
add.why: Smoke of /framework/core/new/1/site/nav/cards/ (2026-11-09): 8 same-origin 404s from root-relative imports (/ui.js, /perf/ui.js, /budget/budget.js, …) written for a separate site root, and mutation/undo/page.js fails in core Page.assign ('Cannot set property items of #<Page> which has only a getter'). The scroll_to_hash crash was guarded in 26ed5c131; the rest is the whole sketch being out of date with core.
